name: robles-stock-pro
description: Sistema Integral de Stock - Robles Pinturerias (React + Node + PostgreSQL)

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run db:setup --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
